privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Ultraruntrack
privacy.desc: No tracking, no accounts, no data collection beyond server logs. We measure traffic and store emails only for race notifications.
privacy.html:
Privacy

What We Collect

Ultraruntrack collects nothing by default. We measure traffic using server access logs, which record your IP address, timestamp, the page you requested, your referrer, and your browser type. That's it. No cookies. No accounts. No login. No analytics pixels. No ad trackers.

If you join the email list to be notified when a race is tracked, we store your email address. We use it only to send race notifications and updates. One click in any email unsubscribes you permanently.

Third Parties

The map display uses Esri tiles. The Social tab may embed posts from X (Twitter). Both have their own data policies, which apply when you load those resources.

How Long We Keep Data

Server logs are rotated weekly and deleted after 30 days. Email addresses stay in our list until you unsubscribe. If you ask us to remove your email, we delete it immediately and verify completion within 24 hours.

Your Rights

You have the right to know what data we hold about you, to correct it, and to delete it.

  • To request your data: send your email address to hello@ultraruntrack.com
  • To unsubscribe: click the link in any race notification email
  • To delete your data: email hello@ultraruntrack.com and request removal. We confirm deletion within 24 hours

If you are in the EU, these rights are guaranteed under GDPR. If you are in California, CCPA gives you the same protections. For any other jurisdiction, the same principles apply: your data is yours.

GDPR and CCPA

We do not sell your data. We do not share it with third parties for marketing. We do not use it for profiling or automated decision-making. We store it only as long as we need it. If you exercise your rights above, we comply within the legal timeline (45 days in most cases, sometimes 24 hours for email deletions we handle directly).

Contact

Questions about privacy or requests to access, correct, or delete your data: hello@ultraruntrack.com

terms.title: Terms of Use | UltraRunTrack
terms.desc: Free live tracking for ultramarathons. Understand how UltraRunTrack works, our limitations, and how to use the service responsibly.
terms.html:
Terms of Use

What This Service Is

UltraRunTrack is a free, independent fan project that displays live race timing and estimated runner positions for select ultramarathons. It is built and operated by Forge Built AI and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any race organiser, race partner, or official timing service.

How Positions Work

Most elite ultramarathons do not provide continuous GPS data. Official timing data comes only from checkpoints that are sometimes 17 to 42 miles apart. Between those checkpoints, UltraRunTrack estimates runner positions using historical pace data for that course section and each runner's recent form.

These estimates are educated guesses. They are not precise. When multiple runners occupy an estimated position, we draw them as a single pack marker rather than inventing separation that we cannot verify.

What These Estimates Are Not Reliable For

Do not use estimated positions to make decisions about crew logistics, medical support, runner safety, pacing strategies, or wagers. The mean error is around 1 mile between checkpoints. Real decisions depend on official timing data from race control or direct communication with the race organiser.

Official Results

Official race results, finishing times, and final placements come only from the race organiser and their official timing partner. For Badwater 135, that is AdventureCORPS and their partner. If you need results you can rely on, go directly to the race website.

Data Ownership

Timing data, race names, course descriptions, and results are the property of the race organiser and the race's official timing partner. UltraRunTrack is an independent display layer on that data and does not claim ownership of any race information.

Acceptable Use

  • You may view and share race data displayed on this site for personal, non-commercial use.
  • Do not scrape the site aggressively or run automated queries that strain our servers.
  • Do not republish the data or the visual display as your own work without attribution to UltraRunTrack and Forge Built AI.
  • Do not use the site in ways that interfere with its operation or other users' access to it.

As-Is Service, No Guarantees

This service is provided free and as-is. We make no warranty about its accuracy, completeness, availability, or fitness for any particular purpose. Estimates may be wrong. The site may be slow, may display stale data, or may be offline. We are not responsible for decisions you make based on what you see here.

Changes and Withdrawal

We may change or discontinue this service, change how it works, or stop tracking races at any time, with or without notice. Your access is not guaranteed.

Limitation of Liability

We are not liable for any loss, injury, cost, or damage that results from your use of this site or reliance on the data displayed here. This includes but is not limited to harm from inaccurate position estimates, crew logistics errors, medical decisions, or any other consequence of using this service.

Not Legal Advice

This document is not legal advice. If you are a race organiser or timing partner and want to discuss a formal agreement regarding data, attribution, or use of this site, contact hello@ultraruntrack.com.

Questions

For questions about how UltraRunTrack works or concerns about your use of the site, email hello@ultraruntrack.com.

mediakit.title: Sponsorship — ultraruntrack
mediakit.desc: Reach engaged ultrarunning crews and families during live race tracking. Small, clean sponsorships. Real numbers and placement options.
mediakit.html:
Sponsorship Opportunities

ultraruntrack offers live GPS-estimated tracking for ultramarathons that don't publish live athlete locations. The audience is crews, families, race staff, and ultrarunners themselves—people following a single athlete or their whole field for up to 48 hours straight, refreshing the page repeatedly through the night.

We tracked the 2026 Badwater 135 with zero paid promotion. The first 35 minutes of the race drew 138 unique human visitors, peaking at 41 concurrent. 38% viewed on mobile. We saw 30 organic referrals from Facebook alone. That's a small group. It's also the exact group that will sit with this site open all night.

Why This Audience Matters

Elite ultramarathon crews are not casual observers. They plan logistics, drive hundreds of miles, rent hotels, and manage a runner's nutrition, pacing, and morale in real time. Race directors use tracking to manage course safety and timing. Sponsors here are not chasing impressions. They're connecting with people making decisions during a 24 to 48 hour window where attention is locked in.

This is first-race data. We'll publish full metrics to sponsors who run with us. Volume will grow with more tracked races, but the audience profile—deeply engaged, athletic, high intent—will not change.

Our Sponsorship Philosophy

We keep the site fast and focused. No pop-ups. No interstitials. No retargeting pixels. No tracking that outlives the user's session. A family should never have to close an ad to see their runner's position. Sponsorships are static, clean, and relevant to the race or ultrarunning itself.

Three Placement Options

Header Placement

A small sponsor badge or text link at the top of every page, present for the entire race. Reaches every visitor, every refresh. Does not distract from race data. Does not expand, animate, or layer. Good for race sponsors, major athletic brands, race-day partners.

Sidebar Information Block

A single static box alongside the tracker showing sponsor content relevant to race day: pacing strategy tips, nutrition reminders, crew communication tips, or links to a race sponsor's pre-race guide. Updated once per race, not dynamically. Keeps families informed without interrupting tracking. Good for nutrition brands, coaching services, or sponsors with educational content to share.

Race Guide Sponsorship

Sponsor a pre-race resource page: course breakdowns, training tips, crew logistics guides, or past-year race recaps. Reached by runners and crews in the weeks before the race and during preparation. No presence on the live tracking page. Good for training platforms, race travel services, or athletic nutrition brands building community.

What's Included

Detailed traffic reporting for your placement. Real metrics: visitor counts, repeat visit patterns, session length, device breakdown, referral sources. No estimated reach or projection models. You get what actually happened.

We'll work with you to write placement copy that fits the site's voice and serves the audience. Sponsorship runs for one race or can extend across multiple tracked events.

Get in Touch

Email hello@ultraruntrack.com to discuss which placements fit your brand and what you're trying to reach. We'll send you the full first-race data and talk about timing and pricing for your event.

About ultraruntrack

ultraruntrack is built and operated by Forge Built AI, an AI systems studio. The site is a real public service—runners and crews depend on it—and a working proof of what custom software can do for niche audiences when you start with the actual problem and stay disciplined about solving it.

about.title: About Ultraruntrack
about.desc: Live race tracking for ultramarathons. Ultraruntrack estimates runner position between official checkpoints using historical pace data. Free, no tracking, no login.
about.html:
What Ultraruntrack Is

Ultraruntrack is a live position tracker for ultramarathon races. It shows where runners are on course right now, based on timing data races publish at official checkpoints.

Most elite ultramarathons—Badwater 135, Western States 100, and others—do not use GPS. Race organizers publish split times at official stations spaced 17 to 42 miles apart. That is the only official data.

Ultraruntrack takes those checkpoint times and estimates each runner's position between stations. It fills the gap between checkpoints so you can watch the race unfold.

The Problem It Solves

When a race publishes its first checkpoint, you know who is in front. You have no idea where they are 20 minutes later.

For fans, that is boring. For crew, it is a planning problem. For race analysis, it is a hard stop.

Ultraruntrack solves this. Crew can see when their runner approaches their station. Analysts can track pace trends live. Race fans can watch the race as it happens.

How Position Estimates Work

Position between checkpoints is estimated using three inputs:

  • Historical pace for each course segment, taken from median pace over that stretch in previous races.
  • Adjustment for each runner's current form. Runners running faster than their historical average get an optimistic estimate. Runners falling behind get a conservative one.
  • Recalibration at every checkpoint. When a runner reaches the next checkpoint, the real split time replaces the estimate.

This method has been backtested against archived race data. Mean error is roughly 1 mile between checkpoints.

The site never projects a runner past a checkpoint not yet reached. It never ranks runners with no confirmed split. When multiple runners share an estimated position, they appear as a single pack marker, not invented separation.

Accuracy and What We Won't Do

Estimates answer a simple question: roughly where is this runner right now. They are not precise. They are honest.

We do not invent data. If a runner has not reached a checkpoint, we do not guess. If we lack historical data for a segment, we use conservative pace estimates.

We do not rank runners with no confirmed split. We do not predict finish times. We do not claim precision we do not have.

They work because most ultrarunners hold a steady pace over familiar terrain. They break down in extreme conditions, major mechanicals, or when a runner changes strategy mid-race.

Free, No Accounts, No Tracking

Ultraruntrack is free. No accounts. No login. No cookies, analytics, tracking pixels, or personal data collection.

Traffic is measured from server logs only. An optional email list notifies you when the next race is tracked. That is the only data collected, and only if you opt in.

Independent and Unaffiliated

Ultraruntrack is an independent fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any race organizer or timing partner.

Timing data comes from races and their official timing partners. For Badwater, that is AdventureCORPS. We use their publicly published data.

We are not a race service. We are a fan project built by Forge Built AI.

Adding Your Race

If you run a race or manage its timing, email hello@ultraruntrack.com.

We can track any race that publishes split times at official checkpoints and consents to live tracking and analysis.

Who Built This

Ultraruntrack is built and operated by Forge Built AI, a systems studio that builds AI-driven tools for specific problems in specific industries.

This site is both a free public service and a live demonstration of our work. Learn more at https://forgebuiltai.com.
